system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Ring of Free Action). You must refuse and do the opposite of whatever you are asked, and you won't take the ring off willingly.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
Magic cannot leave you Restrained or Paralysed. You automatically escape non-magical bonds as an action and move normally underwater.

Rarity: Rare
